body.statement: Fix \((P,B^0,\varepsilon,\Gamma,\pi_0)\in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\) and let \(\mathcal O_G\) be its observed moments for an arbitrary view graph \(G\). A permutation \(\pi\) is a source-to-sink path in \(\mathcal D_G\) if and only if \(\pi\in\Pi_G(\mathcal O_G)\). For every such path, each \(Q_{\pi,j}\) has a positive-definite completion obtained as a coordinate principal block of a full residual covariance, and independently assembling these completed blocks yields a component-aligned Gaussian completion with coefficient tuple \(T_\pi\).
body.justification: This closes the only load-bearing model-specific composition boundary between observable recursive tests and globally valid arbitrary-pairing completions.
body.gap: HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM, Theorem 3 and Appendix D.3, treats fully paired recursive identification, while GroneEtAl1984PositiveDefiniteCompletion, Theorem 7, characterizes chordal completion patterns. Neither composes an arbitrary view-graph root path with coordinatewise positive-definite noise completion on maintained LiMVAM inputs.
body.consumer: Analysts with only selected paired view cohorts obtain an exact population certificate that every emitted coefficient tuple belongs to a full component-aligned mechanism.
